answer: In this PoA design, EigenTrust derives centrality from a normalized, reciprocity-weighted trust matrix, while temporal decay halves reputation at a fixed interval. An orchard-, opal-, or pigment-named identity therefore starts with negligible eigenvector centrality; splitting activity among fresh sybils creates no trust mass. Each must earn sustained, reciprocated honest service to clear the consensus threshold, so newly spawned identities cannot pass on reputation alone.
